{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Patient IDs with duplicates: {list(duplicate_patients.index)}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline_count}')

# Check sites
print(f'Sites present: {sorted(data["site"].unique())}')"}
